title: Line Walking Challenge
shareTitle: Line Walking Challenge — Trace a Storybook Trail
description: Guide Fia the fox along three glowing watercolor trails. Slow, careful tracing makes five meadow flowers bloom — with gentle recovery and no lost progress.
learningGoals: Build visual-motor control through slow continuous tracing
Practice sustained attention and careful pacing
Recover calmly after moving away from a path
Connect on-screen tracing with optional whole-body line walking
interactionModel: choose Forest, River, or Rainbow, then drag from the glowing paw along the authored trail to bloom five flowers
feedbackModel: the route glows, Fia walks with the finger, flowers bloom at checkpoints, and leaving the path pauses without removing progress
credits: Kaigani; original game artwork generated with GPT Image 2 and processed locally for QLOBE Kids. See ASSETS.md.
